title: Dedicated capacity: Surge activation runbook and release synchronization for new compact SKUs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a coordinated runbook and release sequencing plan to launch compact SKU reservations and a surge activation path. This ticket owns sequencing for release notes, billing SKU mapping, support runbooks, partner enablement materials, telemetry gating, and a contingency cutover for capacity spikes.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized release notes draft approved by Docs and Legal and staged in product-release channel
Billing team has validated SKU mappings and a migration path for existing reservations
Ops runbook (play-by-play) published with clear escalation points and rollback steps
Support and Solutions have localized KB articles for top 4 markets (US, EU, UK, APAC)
Telemetry gating metric thresholds defined and test traffic validated in canary cluster
Stakeholder sign-off completed from Engineering, Billing, Support, Sales Engineering, and Partnerships
rollout_steps: Week -3: Draft PRD and high-level timeline published; notify stakeholder channels
Week -2: Billing SKU mapping workshop with Finance and Billing Ops; produce SKU crosswalk
Week -2: Docs draft: release notes, KBs, API change log; start localization handoff
Week -1: Ops runbook rehearsals with Eng on-call and SRE; validate surge activation procedure
Day -2: Final release notes staged; Sales and CS enablement session completed
D0: Release notes published, SKUs activated, telemetry gating enabled; monitor 1st 6 hours
D+1 to D+7: Elevated monitoring, daily rollout syncs, rollback window until D+3 for early adopter cohorts
risks: Billing SKU misalignment causes incorrect invoicing for early reservations
Telemetry thresholds too conservative causing false positives and unnecessary rollbacks
Localization delays for APAC markets leading to support confusion
Unexpected capacity pressure in a single AZ due to misrouted canary traffic
Docs or release notes not approved by Legal in time for publication
